lead: A `.nvst` case has no clock to move, so any property over more than one time step is a Rust test.
body: `Core\Test::advance` refuses where no `#[Test(at: ...)]` fixed a clock, and a case is top-level statements never inside one (`test-advance-refuses-without-a-fixed-clock.nvst` says so). A case can only watch `Core\Time::sleep` across a wall-clock second, asserting the biconditional *the answer moved exactly when the step did* rather than "unchanged" (flaky one run in thirty); the step axis belongs in the module's own `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
